title: Dateinamen strikt und verlustfrei als UTF8/UTF16

runtime.limits: Software-only local KVM4; no native hardware/Windows/host CPU-MSR-cache/TCG/forced ISA. Strict Unicode scalar subset intentionally rejects foreign unpaired UTF16; FAT short-only OEM bytes require explicit codepage and return controlled I/O. FAT long file rename retains explicit non-atomic copy/delete fallback; NTFS $UpCase/FAT ASCII collation retained, no normalization. Protocol/UI/graphemes remain42..44.

standard.limits: Exactly one final normal unchanged Suite3/all4, full original readback. Actual FS41 NTFS/FAT UTF8/UTF16 CRUD and negative scalar/capacity tests are independent of STANDARD. All14 measured Spectra sources/references unchanged. Previous40 original retained. No native hardware/Windows acceptance or isolated FS-performance gain inferred. Protocol/app/grapheme work remains42..44.

implementation: Allocation-free shared R4STD strict UTF8/UTF16: shortest sequences/scalars, supplementary pairs, LE even byte spans, full output-capacity preflight before writes. units_required counts UTF16 units; validate_le counts UTF8 bytes.

Public filesystem path admission validates the entire raw path before normalization or filesystem/cache lookup, strips only a valid drive prefix for component budgeting, rejects NUL/noncanonical input and components above255UTF16units. Registry value names retain their independent byte contract.

NTFS lookup, create/write/append/delete, directory create/delete, rename/publish/replace and FILE_NAME building use the same name validation.255UTF16units/510LEbytes and UTF8 result bytes stay distinct. Foreign FILE_NAME scalars validated before collation/entry conversion. Existing record/link/cache/dirty/index/rollback owners retained.

FAT/VFAT reads/writes use the shared unit codec. Full LFN checksum/order/padding/pair validation is retained, including surrogate splits over13unit slots. Complete LFNs never silently degrade to8.3aliases on conversion failure. Invalid input is rejected before mutation/cache invalidation. Unsupported foreign entries yield controlled I/O without rewriting raw bytes.

FAT short entries contain no OEM-codepage declaration; without a volume-codepage contract, non-ASCII short-only bytes are rejected rather than guessed as UTF8/437. Valid LFNs remain usable independently of short alias bytes. U+FFFF is rejected before FAT writes because FFFF is the LFN padding marker.

Existing NTFS $UpCase code-unit and FAT ASCII case comparison retained; no normalization/full Unicode case folding. NTFS rename retains record/creation identity. FAT long file rename retains explicit non-atomic copy/delete fallback; long directory rename/atomic-LFN rename are outside this contract.

unaccepted_attempts: Native-1: new probe incorrectly used synthetic dirEntry0/1 and expected basenames; corrected to start2 and compare qualified basename. No runtime owner fault or STANDARD run. Original failure/source/artifact retained.
native_groups: malformed UTF8 aliases, odd/unpaired UTF16, unchanged outputs and whole-path preflight
exact255unit/UTF8byte budgets and immutable malformed foreign FILE_NAME
LFN split pairs13/26/39/max255, checksum/completion and explicit OEM rejection
tests.guest: SPECTRA CHECK FILESYSTEM /NAMES on fresh C: NTFS and internal boot FAT, all CRUD/content/enum/NTFS identity,40 malformed API calls and unchanged write counters

boundaries: Only local real KVM4 with normal host CPU and software/RAM; no native hardware/Windows/host MSR-cache/device probes, TCG or forced ISA. Windows host starter paths are implemented, not executed here.
Unicode-scalar filename subset intentionally rejects foreign unpaired UTF16 rather than preserving arbitrary Windows WCHAR sequences. No guessed OEM mapping, file repair or foreign raw writes.

Guest negative proof covers public UTF8 APIs and actual no-write counters/content; malformed foreign raw FILE_NAME/LFN data is tested at its actual resident pure owner on the host, without disk corruption injection.
No normalization, locale-independent full case folding, graphemes, shaping or Bidi claim. SSH/FTP/UI/graphemes remain42..44.
STANDARD is unchanged Suite3/all4 and assesses whole-system context; it does not isolate filename performance. Previous40 original export and all sealed Source/Work stay unchanged.
